inc-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: realtime.p95 and realtime.p99 spikes detected for hosted-api /generate in us-west-2 since ~1779501000. Streaming stall increase observed on v2-stream. p95 ~4200ms (SLO 3000ms), p99 ~12200ms (SLO 8000ms). Auto-escalation to on-call.
Ben (oncall): I’m on it. paging @Ben (oncall) — starting quick triage.
Carla R: Copy. Adding context: dashboards show a simultaneous increase in queue depth on gpu-pool-3 and a spike in KV cache miss rate. Could be cold KV eviction after the coord service restarted.
Alice M: Noting customer impact: ACME corp reported multiple incomplete streaming responses at 11:41 PDT via support ticket #8543. They use us-west endpoint.
Ben (oncall): Quick checklist: 1) Recent deploys? 2) Any infra alarms? 3) Can we route traffic away from gpu-pool-3?
release-bot: Deploy 2026-03-14T11:35Z -> rollout v2-stream-2026-03-14 finished to us-west-2 (canary 10% -> 100%).
Dave S: That lines up with the timeline. I’m querying the request histogram now.
Ben (oncall): Run these queries: 
```
# p95/p99 over last 30m
SELECT percentile(latency_ms,95) as p95, percentile(latency_ms,99) as p99 FROM requests WHERE route='/generate' AND region='us-west-2' SINCE 30m
```
Carla R: Grafana quick link: https://grafana.internal/r/hosts/realtime?panel=latency-us-west (watching)
SRE rotation bot: NOTE: on-call handoff scheduled in 45m. Current on-call: Ben (primary), backup: Carla R.
Ben (oncall): Initial findings: p99 is concentrated on requests with streaming enabled and seq_len>1024. KV cache miss ratio up from 2%->18% after rollout. CPU on coord-service briefly hit 85% around the same time.
Alice M: Are there queued requests piling up on the routing proxy? I see 400-500ms extra queuing in the proxy logs.
Dave S: Logs show repeated 503 from model-worker-7 when retrieving cached KV blobs: "timeout reading cache from s3-like-store". That would bump upstream latency.
Ben (oncall): Action items I'm executing now: 1) Temporarily divert 30% of traffic to us-east-1 for /generate; 2) scale up coord-service replicas by +2; 3) enable fallback model variant (quantized) for streaming routes if available.
Carla R: I can patch autoscaler to add nodes to gpu-pool-3; giving it a +2 GPU headroom now.
Ben (oncall): Routing change applied: traffic-split updated -> us-west-2 70%, us-east-1 30%. Will monitor.
Alice M: Notifying ACME support: "We're investigating elevated latency for us-west; routing some traffic to another region, should reduce errors. Will update in 15m." :phone:
release-bot: Rollback option: deploy rollback command available: `deploy rollback v2-stream-2026-03-14 --region us-west-2` (requires approvals).
Ben (oncall): Hold on rollback until we confirm KV store flakiness. Rollback might cause more cache churn. Carla, can you confirm S3-like store metrics?
Carla R: Storage latency spiked ~11:35-11:45 due to background compaction job kicked off. Compaction now 60% done; ops flagged it as high IO. I've asked infra to pause compaction for this bucket.
Dave S: After routing change, p95 dropped to ~2700ms and errors for ACME are down. p99 still elevated but trending down (now ~9200ms).
Ben (oncall): Good. Continue monitoring. If p99 < 8000ms after 10m, we can declare mitigated. Meanwhile, keep customers updated.
Alice M: Support updated ACME: "We've routed some traffic to another region and applied mitigations; will follow up when fully resolved." They replied :thumbsup:.
SRE rotation bot: Incident state: triage in progress. Paging escalation threshold still open if p99 > SLO for 15m.
Carla R: Infra paused compaction; KV storage latency back to normal within 3m. coord-service replicas scaled. Cache warmup started; eviction tail is dropping.
Ben (oncall): Final checks: run a synthetic stream with long sequence to verify stability.
Dave S: Synthetic ran 5x with stable streaming throughput, p99 ~5600ms for that test.
Ben (oncall): Marking incident as "mitigated" for now. Will keep the thread open for 1h for regression watch. Summary for postmortem: deploy + background compaction overlapped causing KV miss storm -> upstream model-worker timeouts -> streaming tail latency spike. Mitigation: region split, scale coord-service, pause compaction, enable fallback variant.
Carla R: I’ll start a postmortem doc and capture timeline. Thanks all. :heart:
inc-bot: Incident note recorded. Severity: Sev2. Tickets created: PM-1192, SRE-1193.
